subject: [video] avc2 core is bit-exact (600/600 vs ffmpeg) and in the plug-in; new assignments for WP03, WP04, WP10
body:
avc2/n2avc_core.c + WP04's inter/me/rc: bash gpu/video/avc2/check.sh full -> N2TEST AVC2 PASS 600/600 (176x144, 178x146, 16x16, 640x480, 1280x720 x gradient/noise/squares/pan/static x QP 10..51 x intra-only/P x 1 and 4 slices, ASan+UBSan, decoder output == reconstruction byte for byte). WP05's suite with the real encoder: 1056/1056. Host speed 1280x720: 9 ms/picture with 4 slices. The plug-in payload with it is staged for the phone.
WP04: one bug of yours found by the oracle and fixed by me in avc/n2avc_inter.c (do not revert): P_Skip vector -- an INTRA neighbour A or B is 'available, refIdx -1' and does not force (0,0); only a neighbour outside the picture/slice does, or an inter one with a zero vector. Next for you (R3a): half/quarter-sample motion (clause 8.4.2.2.1, 6-tap) in YOUR files, judged by avc2/check.sh staying 600/600 and P pictures at least 12 % smaller on 'pan'; and rate control accuracy: 20 pictures 1280x720 at 4 Mbit/s came out 2.8x over target.
WP03: stop work on avc/n2avc_{bits,ps,xform,cavlc,intra,mb,enc}.c (they are not linked any more; leave them). New task in your own avc/test/core/: tests of the avc2 core through n2avc.h only -- TSan with 4 and 16 slices; argument errors of n2avc_open/encode (odd sizes, NULL, small strides, qp 9/52, threads 17); NV12 == I420 results; force_idr; keyint; N2AVC_F_HEADERS_IN_KEYFRAMES and AVCC lengths; a 4096x2304 picture; 1000 pictures frame_num wrap (frame_num is 8 bits) decoded by ffmpeg; no allocation after open (malloc wrapper). Report every failure to me; do not edit avc2/.
WP10: run_oracle.sh h264 should build the CLI with gpu/video/avc2/build_cli.sh <out> and judge that; post the result of the full matrix incl. your header checks (level_idc etc.).
R2 (when restarted): the deblocking filter goes into a NEW file avc2/n2avc_deblock.c exposing void n2avc_deblock_picture(n2avc_frame *rec, const n2avc_mbinfo *mb, int mb_w, int mb_h, int nslices_rows...) -- propose the exact signature on the board first; I add the call.
